name: ee_law_search
description: Search Estonian national legislation (Riigi Teataja: acts, regulations, orders) by title word or abbreviation, e.g. "isikuandmete kaitse" or abbreviation "IKS". By default only acts in force today are returned (set in_force_only=false for repealed acts and older versions too). Returns id (globaalID of the text version), title, type, issuer, validity dates, in-force status and a link; 25 per page, use page to continue. Estonian-language titles. Pair with ee_law_get for the text.

query.description: Word(s) from the Estonian title, e.g. "isikuandmete kaitse"

abbreviation.description: Official abbreviation, e.g. "IKS" (use instead of query)

in_force_only.description: Only acts in force today (default true)

name: ee_law_get
description: Fetch one Estonian legal act text version by id from ee_law_search (e.g. "130062026052" for the current Personal Data Protection Act). Returns title, abbreviation, type, issuer, adoption date, State Gazette citation, in-force dates and amendment list, and the text. Pass section (e.g. "6" or "10^1" for § 10 superscript 1) for one § only; without it the text is capped at max_chars with a contents list. Text is the consolidated version as published in Riigi Teataja, in Estonian.

section.description: Section (paragrahv) number, e.g. "6", "10^1" for § 10 with superscript 1

max_chars.description: Cap on returned text when no section is given (default 20000, max 100000)
